ValidationRule.description: This validation rule restricts users from changing the Application status whose profile is other than 'System Administrator' or 'Board Staff'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(AND(Is_Auto_Approval_Allowed__c, ISCHANGED(Is_Auto_Approval_Allowed__c))), NOT( AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId),ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Under Review')) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Submitted')), NOT( OR( Contains($Profile.Name,"System Administrator"), Contains($Profile.Name,"Employer Portal User"), Contains($Profile.Name,"Board Staff"), Contains($Profile.Name,"IBM Profile"), AND(Contains($Profile.Name,"Support Staff"),ISPICKVAL(ApplicationType,'Renewal')), AND(Contains($Profile.Name,"MODPR Integration User"),ISPICKVAL(Status,'Rejected'),OR(License_Type_Name__c == 'Registered Nurse', License_Type_Name__c == 'Licensed Practical Nurse')) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please contact to system admin, you don't have permission to change the Internal application status
